notes: Lead: head of product (Maya Lin). Target product: semantic search for 1,200 mid-market merchants. Wants hosted first for quick time-to-value, then Dedicated for cost predictability once POC passes. Key quotes: "We need nightly reindex to finish within the 2am ET window and not spike cloud costs." Priorities: throughput for batch jobs, smooth Pinecone integration, token-level cost visibility. Security: must support SSO and provide SOC2 evidence; legal asked for data residency language for EU customers. Early concerns: current Pinecone plan cost for 100M vectors and read QPS at peak. Trial constraints: only synthetic PII allowed in POC; full data requires DPA + DSR clauses. AE notes: customer is pragmatic — will move quickly if benchmarks show 30% lower per-vector cost vs their current pipeline. SE notes: will test quantized open models (meta-llama-2-7b) for embeddings and small NN encoder for pre-filtering.
workload_summary: Nightly batch: upsert ~200k vectors per night (initial), plan to scale to 5M/month. Query workload: 150-300 QPS at peak for similarity ranking across merchant catalogs. Mix of online near-RT search (95ms target after vector retrieval) and offline batch enrichments.
perf_targets: Batch throughput: >=8k vectors/minute during peak reindex. Online latency: 80-120ms end-to-end on similarity rerank (vector DB roundtrip excluded). Retry/fallback: degrade to smaller quantized model when Dedicated capacity constrained.
poc_plan: 1) Hosted API trial (2 weeks): integrate embedding pipeline -> Pinecone, measure batch throughput and cost. 2) Stress test with 500k doc mock set; tune batching and concurrency. 3) Demo Dedicated pricing and run identical workload on 2-week Dedicated trial (accounted in pricing deck). 4) Present cost delta and SLA options to procurement. Success criteria: nightly reindex completes within maintenance window, cost per vector reduced by >=25% vs baseline, latency SLO met on 95th percentile.
commercial_notes: Customer prefers a 12-month Dedicated commit if we can guarantee burst capacity for sale days. Asking for a blended price band showing Hosted vs Dedicated break-even point at 150k vectors/day. Procurement flagged preference for quarterly invoicing.
